_comment: Shared by backend/tests/test_moat_not_rated.py and frontend/lib/overallScore.test.ts: both implementations of the Overall verdict must produce these results. A case's optional `weights.overall` is the saved weight set it runs under (absent = `defaults`); Moat is always 31. `rounding_cases` sit on an exact .5, where Python's round (half to even) and JS Math.round differ; `parity_cases` are generated random weight sets (expected values produced by the backend).
